npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

teleporter/35506-1.htm.text: During castle siege his jail can become weak... What if demon will escape?

ai/individual/Venom/35506-02.html.text: When attacking a castle, its defenses can easily be paralyzed.... What if that demon escapes?

ai/individual/Venom/35506.html.text: The roar of that scary demon in the dungeon always makes me want to run away! I know the dungeon is well-built, but if its defenses are broken, it could collapse!
